text: ACME Corp reported revenue of $125 million for fiscal 2024, compared with $100 million for fiscal 2023. Operating income was $20 million in fiscal 2024.
In its 2025 outlook, ACME Corp stated that it expected revenue between $135 million and $145 million, subject to market conditions.
Beta Ltd reported fiscal 2024 revenue of $80 million and operating income of $12 million. The filing defines operating margin as operating income divided by revenue.
